decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to aggressively build up devotion to green in order to generate massive amounts of mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and overwhelm the opponent with powerful green creatures and spells. The deck utilizes cards such as Karn, the Great Creator, Storm the Festival, and Old-Growth Troll to apply early pressure and maintain a strong board presence. Additionally, cards like Lovestruck Beast and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provide additional utility and card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana quickly by untapping it with cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands. This mana is then used to cast powerful spells and combo off with Emergent Ultimatum to search for key pieces like Omniscience and Behold the Beyond, allowing the player to draw their entire deck or cast multiple spells in a single turn. The deck also includes some control elements like Extinction Event and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with powerful creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant, supported by mana ramp from Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to control the board and push damage through. Flexibility is key, with Boseiju, Who Endures and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance providing additional utility, while Esika's Chariot offers a way to generate extra value from creature tokens. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats and close out the game quickly.

This deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang, Okiba Boss to create a powerful combo with Can't Stay Away and Satyr Wayfinder to quickly dig through the deck for key pieces. Grisly Salvage and Raffine's Informant help with card selection and filling the graveyard for Eldritch Evolution. Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provide additional threats on the board while Polukranos, Unchained and Parhelion II serve as finishers. The deck is built to efficiently combo off and overwhelm the opponent with a mix of graveyard recursion, card advantage, and powerful creatures.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a wide board presence with efficient mana dorks and low-cost threats. The deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain board presence through mid-game threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Werewolf Pack Leader. The inclusion of powerful vehicles like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot allows for additional reach and versatility. The deck also utilizes versatile removal spells like Obliterating Bolt to clear the way for attacks. Lair of the Hydra provides a late-game mana sink to pump up creatures for a final push to victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive play using powerful Rakdos creatures and removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. It utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, and Graveyard Trespasser to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With strong removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats and disrupt their strategy, ultimately leading to victory through efficient and aggressive play.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to play threats ahead of schedule, while also leveraging powerful creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant. The inclusion of Mutavault and Lair of the Hydra provides additional threats that can dodge removal spells. The deck aims to apply pressure early on and maintain momentum with cards like The Akroan War and Reckless Stormseeker, while finishing off the opponent with devastating spells like Obliterating Bolt.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to tutor for powerful creatures and enchantments to control the game. The key strategy is to set up a board state where Enigmatic Incarnation can consistently fetch threats and answers from the deck, while using Fires of Invention to cast multiple spells in a turn. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. By carefully managing resources and utilizing the tutor ability of Enigmatic Incarnation effectively, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Llanowar Elves to cast powerful threats such as Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional card advantage and utility. The deck also includes support cards like Oath of Nissa and Wolfwillow Haven to help with consistency and acceleration. The win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and powerful spells, backed up by plenty of mana generation.

The deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss to combo with other cards like Parhelion II and Esika's Chariot to generate powerful synergies and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command to control the opponent's hand and board state, while utilizing cards like Grisly Salvage and Satyr Wayfinder to fill the graveyard for additional value. Additionally, cards like Can't Stay Away and Raffine's Informant provide further utility and synergy within the combo-heavy strategy.

The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo using cards like Raffine's Informant, Satyr Wayfinder, and Stitcher's Supplier to fill the graveyard with key pieces. Eldritch Evolution is used to tutor for the necessary cards while Thoughtseize provides disruption for the opponent. Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship help control the board and provide additional threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency in casting the combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to quickly set up the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The deck also includes cards like Secrets of the Key and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to help find and protect combo pieces. The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and synergies within the Selesnya color combination to overwhelm opponents quickly. The key strategy involves playing cards like Righteous Valkyrie and Youthful Valkyrie to buff each other and other creatures, while utilizing cards like Collected Company to search for more threats. The deck also includes cards like Bishop of Wings and Resplendent Angel to provide additional value and resilience to the aggressive strategy. Overall, the goal is to establish a wide board presence and quickly close out the game before opponents can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing Azorius Spirits to maintain tempo and pressure on the opponent with a combination of cheap and evasive creatures. By utilizing cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a board presence with cards like Empyrean Eagle and Supreme Phantom. Collected Company is used to refill the board quickly and ensure a steady stream of threats. The main goal of this deck is to attack aggressively while controlling the game through targeted disruption and tempo plays.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing fast creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Atarka's Command, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and win the game before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Rimrock Knight and Reckless Bushwhacker helps to maintain pressure and close out the game swiftly. The mana base is optimized for consistent aggression and quick deployment of threats.
